scope: Post-study single-seed train/validation diagnostic; no held-out claim or replacement of released models
hypothesis: Reducing PPO learning rate from 0.0003 to 0.0001 may reduce update drift and preserve deterministic validation success during short continuation
primary_comparison: Final endpoint full-trajectory success count on all 24 validation scenes; no checkpoint selection
secondary_diagnostics: PPO approximate KL and clipping fraction
Gaussian action clipping before bounded environment input
deterministic policy drift on common initial validation observations
continuation_semantics: Restore identical selected weights and optimizer state; reset environment and RNG identically for both arms. This does not reconstruct the original run's missing environment/RNG state.
budget_estimate: Historical 177 decisions/s implies about 139s combined training plus roughly 125s validation; allow 4-6 minutes. No automatic budget extension.
decision_rule: Report both arms and all failures, including a null/negative result. Any advantage is exploratory on a reused validation set. No new test evaluation, no original model replacement.
